metadata.title: Anthropic IPO update, Oracle earnings, August CPI: What to Watch

content.text:
Oops, something went wrong
Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come throughout next week, including earnings results from Jersey Mike's (JMKE), Oracle (ORCL), and Adobe (ADBE); August's Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data; and the possible IPO of AI giant Anthropic (ANTH.PVT).
Time now for to watch the week of September 7th. Markets will be closed on Monday for the Labor Day holiday.
Following that, we're keeping a close eye on Anthropic. Investors could finally be getting a much clearer look under the hood of one of the world's most valuable AI companies.
Claude Maker is reportedly preparing to release its IPO prospectus after Labor Day, head of a possible public listing in the coming months.
Checking in on earnings, Oracle reporting quarterly results on Thursday, analysts watching its cloud infrastructure business with strong results across the broader AI market pointing to potentially stronger growth.
Analysts are looking for Oracle Cloud infrastructure growth of about 116% when the company's massive backlog also remains in focus.
And finally, fresh inflation data that's coming out to end the week on Friday with the August consumer price index or CPI, economists forecasting headline CPI to rise 0.4% up from July, while core CPI holds steady on a month-over-month basis.
